outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: 4507 pregnant women with GDM (409 with SARS-CoV-2 infection and 4598 without) from two German registries
finding: GDM combined with SARS-CoV-2 infection during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of adverse fetal and neonatal outcomes compared to GDM without SARS-CoV-2 infection.
